name: Gathering Idols

angles.text: As a dwarf, you join excavators seeking ancient artifacts in trogg-infested ruins and the secrets they hold.
As an Alliance adventurer, you help dwarven expeditions secure dangerous relics before savage troggs cause more havoc.

faq.answer: Magmar Fellhew is an excavator seeking to recover carved stone idols from an excavation site troggs overran.
The idols are mysterious carved stone relics unearthed at an excavation site. Their unsettling power drives nearby troggs into a berserk frenzy.
faq.q: What are the carved stone idols?

faq.answer: The idols exert a strange, inexplicable influence on troggs. When the creatures possess them, wild fury drives them berserk.
faq.q: Why do the idols make the troggs go berserk?

faq.answer: Magmar Fellhew wants the idols recovered safely so he can study their origins and properties, and remove the volatile relics from trogg hands.
faq.q: Why does Magmar Fellhew want the idols collected?

faq.answer: Troggs surfaced abruptly from the excavation site shortly after the idols were discovered. They drove the excavators from the ruins.
faq.q: What happened at the excavation site?

faq.answer: Troggs carry the carved stone idols at the excavation site where the relics were first unearthed.

sections.body: Researchers uncovered a large cache of strange, carved stone idols shortly before savage troggs surfaced and overran the excavation site. The attack drove the expedition from the ruins before any formal study could begin. Now the troggs clutch the relics and prowl the site, barring a peaceful return.
sections.title: The Unearthed Relics

sections.body: The troggs seem deeply affected by the idols, beyond merely taking them. Their strange carvings exert an unsettling power that drives the creatures into an uncontrollable rage. Magmar Fellhew wants to study the idols safely and quell the frenzy gripping the area, so he seeks to take them from trogg hands.
sections.title: A Savage Frenzy

summary: At an excavation site, troggs clutch the carved idols Magmar Fellhew seeks. The relics have driven them into a violent frenzy.
